successCriteria.description: `BaseEntity` interface is defined and exported from `src/modules/BaseEntity/BaseEntity.model.ts` with exactly three fields: `id: string`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date`
`LeaveRequestStatus` enum is defined and exported from `src/modules/LeaveStatus/LeaveStatus.model.ts` with exactly four members: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED`
`LeaveType` enum is defined and exported from `src/modules/LeaveType/LeaveType.model.ts` with exactly three members: `ANNUAL`, `SICK`, `EMERGENCY`
Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/LeaveStatus/` verify all four `LeaveRequestStatus` enum values exist and are distinct
Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/LeaveType/` verify all three `LeaveType` enum values exist and are distinct
Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/BaseEntity/` verify the `BaseEntity` interface shape — that an object conforming to it has `id`, `createdAt`, and `updatedAt` of the correct types

constraints: All TypeScript files must use strict TypeScript (no implicit any, strict null checks) as declared in HARNESS.json
Modules must only import from each other's public entry point (`index.ts`), never from internal files directly — per ARCHITECTURE.md dependency rules
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards instead (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`)
Jest is the test framework; tests must pass with `npx jest --passWithNoTests` as defined in HARNESS.json verification
outOfScope: Employee domain model and repository (Phase 2) — `Employee` interface, `EmploymentStatus` enum, `IEmployeeRepository`, `EmployeeRepository`
LeavePolicy domain model and repository (Phase 3) — `LeavePolicy` interface, `CreateLeavePolicyDto`, `ILeavePolicyRepository`, `LeavePolicyRepository`
LeaveRequest domain model and repository (Phase 4) — `LeaveRequest` interface, `CreateLeaveRequestDto`, `ILeaveRepository`, `LeaveRepository`
Leave service with business logic for apply/approve/reject/cancel (Phase 5)
Leave controller and Fastify HTTP routes (Phase 6)
Database migrations for leave management tables (Phase 7)
LeaveBalance domain model, repository, and balance service (Phases 8-9)
Balance controller, routes, and leave-balance integration endpoints (Phase 10)
Any database access, repository implementations, or Knex usage — this phase is pure domain types only

ambiguities.description: ARCHITECTURE.md lists `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts` as containing `LeaveType` and `LeaveStatus`, while this phase creates them under `src/modules/LeaveType/` and `src/modules/LeaveStatus/`. The intent is explicit about the module locations, but the shared types file may need reconciliation in a later phase.
